description: Introduction and overview of the Kamov Ka-52 Alligator: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Kamov Ka-52 Alligator is a twin-engine attack helicopter with coaxial counter-rotating rotors, entering Russian service in 2011. It is the world's only operational helicopter with ejection seats. The two-seat Ka-52 added radar and reconnaissance capability to the single-seat Ka-50.
